caption: The drawing depicts a single elongated, cylindrical object with a rounded tip at one end and a wider, flared circular base at the other. The body of the object is smooth and has a blue-green, translucent color with hints of white highlights and several small, pale circular marks, giving it a glass-like appearance. Near the middle of the object, slightly closer to the flared base, there is a small, circular protrusion with what appears to be a brown cap or stopper on top, suggesting it may be a vessel or container. The drawing is framed by a thin red rectangular border, and in the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing of the same object labeled with a “9” underneath, indicating its length. The background is plain and off-white, and the overall composition is centered within the bordered area.
title: Nursing Bottle
